purpose: Prospective input/workload diagnostics; not final model acceptance
measurement: Both arms have existing instrumentation. Ratio tests incremental workload probes, not total instrumentation overhead. Report CPU/RSS and probe durations separately.
validation: Freeze input clusters/coefficients from old data; new runs are prospective timing diagnostics on existing input trajectories. Additional workload feature fits are exploratory only.
success: Collection/probe correctness required. ATE, invalid poses, late windows preserved; no performance-based exclusions. Probability conditions remain separate.
stop: Acquisition failure stops collection. Measurement failures retained and prevent acceptance; independent remaining collection may diagnose robustness. No E5/E6.
